attchmntText: Cheviot Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Cheviot Company Limited approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The Board granted an unmodified opinion via its statutory auditors. Revenue from operations was 18,981.67 Lakhs for the quarter and 36,036.83 Lakhs for the half-year. Profit before tax stood at 1,470.36 Lakhs for the quarter and 7,011.03 Lakhs for the half-year. Profit for the period was 1,095.85 Lakhs for the quarter and 5,625.00 Lakhs for the half-year. Basic earnings per share were 18.76 Rupees for the quarter and 96.29 Rupees for the half-year. Total assets reached 80,661.23 Lakhs as of 30th September 2026. Net cash from operating activities was 2,806.53 Lakhs for the half-year.
